main_text.l: 10 Vnū corp*, vnus spiritus, quem-admodum vocati estis 113.a

11 Propterea inter vos multi sunt infirmi & dormiunt multi 207.b
12 Aemulemini charismata meliora 273.a
12 Membris minus honestis honorē vberiore apponimus 267.a
12 Oia factus sum omnibus 214.a

15 Comedamus & bibamus, cras enim moriemur 232.b

15 Modicum fermenti totam massam corrumpit 110.b

15 Vt in Adamo oēs mortui sunt, ita omnes in Christo viuificabuntur 194.a

page.notes: Page is an index of Pauline references; the left-hand numbers are part of each column. Doubtful readings: "Oia factus" (perhaps Omnia, printed so); "qui af-fidet" (perhaps assidet, the long s is hard to tell apart from f); "228.b" in the Seminatur line (the number may read 22S.b); "Caro concupiscit ... 12." (the page number may be incomplete); "Nō enim possumus ... sed 420.a" ends on a word break as printed; "Oportet autem hæreses esse|ut" bracket mark read as a space. Running head printed as "INDEX" with a decorative mark, read as "INDEX X.". No page number printed.
